supplier: Essity UK Limited (formerly BSN Medical Ltd)

decisions.why: Cutimed Siltec range are silicone foam dressings for exuding wounds - advanced dressings.
Cutimed Siltec Sorbact and Sorbion Sorbact are antimicrobial foam dressings for infected exuding wounds.
Cutimed Sorbact Pad/Ribbon/Hydro/Swab are antimicrobial advanced wound dressings.
Cuticell Contact/Classic are wound contact dressings; Cutimed Protect spray/foam are periwound skin protectant products sold alongside the advanced dressing range.
Cutimed Gel is a hydrogel used for wound debridement.
Cutimed Epiona is an advanced tissue-regeneration wound dressing.
